description: Put an earlier published state back on the real site. Use the id from runzero_list_releases. This CHANGES what visitors see. It does not touch the code: anything changed since is still there and still waiting, so this undoes what is published, not the work. If the user wants an announcement removed rather than the whole site rolled back, edit the page instead — going back also removes every other change made since.
name: runzero_restore_release
title: Restore release
